query: Samuel Pepys diary December 1667 naval figure mentioned
information:
"Samuel Pepys, the English diarist and Chief Secretary to the Admiralty, mentions his cousin Admiral Edward Montagu—later the 1st Earl of Sandwich—in his diary every December from 1660 through 1667, but not in December 1668."

"Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich in the Diary"
